title: Exo2EgoHOI: Hand-Object-Interaction Aware Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38615v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide valuable visual experience for embodied intelligence, yet collecting such data at scale is costly. Exocentric-to-egocentric video generation offers a scalable alternative by transforming abundant third-person manipulation videos into first-person observations. However, existing methods often struggle to faithfully preserve demonstrated hand-object interactions (HOI) across large viewpoint changes due to insufficient fine-grained interaction guidance and weak object-centric anchoring. We present Exo2EgoHOI, an HOI-aware video generative framework for interaction-preserving exocentric-to-egocentric translation. To preserve fine-grained HOI, we introduce a unified 4D HOI prior that combines scene geometry, articulated hand renderings, and dense hand-object relation fields, together with a dual-branch residual adapter for injecting structural and relational cues into the video generation back

translated_title: Exo2EgoHOI：手-物交互感知的第三人称到第一人称视频生成
translated_abstract: 第一人称视角的人类操作视频为具身智能提供了宝贵的视觉经验，然而大规模收集此类数据成本高昂。第三人称到第一人称的视频生成为此提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，能够将丰富的第三人称操作视频转化为第一人称观察。然而，由于缺乏细粒度的交互引导以及较弱的以物体为中心的锚定，现有方法在大幅视角变化下往往难以忠实保留演示中的手-物交互（HOI）。我们提出了Exo2EgoHOI，一个面向交互保持的第三人称到第一人称转换的HOI感知视频生成框架。为了保留细粒度的HOI，我们引入了一个统一的4D HOI先验，它结合了场景几何、铰接手部渲染以及密集的手-物关系场，并配有双分支残差适配器，用于将结构和关系线索注入视频生成骨干网络。
tldr: 该论文提出Exo2EgoHOI框架，通过统一的4D手-物交互先验（融合场景几何、铰接手部渲染与密集手-物关系场）和双分支残差适配器，在第三人称到第一人称的视频生成中忠实保留细粒度的手-物交互。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Exo2EgoHOI, an HOI-aware video generation framework that faithfully preserves fine-grained hand-object interactions during exocentric-to-egocentric video translation by leveraging a unified 4D HOI prior and a dual-branch residual adapter.
